name: magellan-lite
description: Know what your change breaks before you commit it: the checklist where the damage lands, the verdict in the status bar, conflicts with your team's work in progress, and a map of what the change reaches.

commands.title: Share my work in progress with my team
Check against my team's work in progress

viewsWelcome.contents: Checking your change against the last commit...

Open a folder with Python code, and Magellan Lite checks your change every time you save.
[Open Folder](command:workbench.action.files.openFolder)

Magellan Lite could not run. Usually the Python in `magellanLite.pythonPath` cannot import it: run `pip install -e <the Magellan Lite repo>` with that Python.
[Set the Python](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22magellanLite.pythonPath%22%5D)
[Show output](command:magellanLite.showOutput)
[Try again](command:magellanLite.check)

Nothing to check in what your change touched. Edit and save a Python file to check it again.
[Show the map](command:magellanLite.showMap)
Nothing your change didn't edit is reached by it (or there is no change yet).

See what only your work and a teammate's break together, before either of you merges.
[Share my work in progress](command:magellanLite.share)
[Check against my team](command:magellanLite.team)

magellanLite.pythonPath.description: The Python that has Magellan Lite installed (pip install -e <the repo>).

magellanLite.checkOnSave.description: Check the change every time a Python file is saved.

magellanLite.against.description: What to compare the working tree with: git:REV, or a folder holding the old version.

magellanLite.shareOnSave.markdownDescription: After you save a Python file, share your work in progress with your team (`magellan-lite share`: your working tree goes to `refs/wip/<your name>` on the git remote, at most once every 15 seconds), so your teammates' **Team suite** and `team` checks see it as you go. **Anyone who can read the repository can read it**: on a public repository, everyone.
